description: The standard deduction for tax year 2027 (or 2026) for a filing status from IRS Rev. Proc. 2026-35, with the additional amount for each filer who is 65 or older or blind, the dependent rule (greater of a floor or earned income plus a fixed amount), and the change from the other year.

age_65_or_older_count.description: How many filers are 65 or older by December 31 of the tax year (0 to 2, joint returns only 2). Default 0.

blind_count.description: How many filers are blind (0 to 2, joint returns only 2). Default 0.

can_be_claimed_as_dependent.description: True if someone else can claim this filer as a dependent. Default false.

earned_income.description: Earned income of the dependent filer, used only when can_be_claimed_as_dependent is true.

name: get_standard_deduction
title: Get 2027 standard deduction
